notes: The owner directive: below Research Notes on each security, a Perspectives panel — the server collects all the data it has access to for that name, passes what is necessary to an LLM, and asks for an assessment grounded in the classic value disciplines (margin of safety, investment vs speculation, earnings power over story, balance-sheet strength, owner earnings, the market quotation as servant not guide, an explicit refusal to predict) — with the hard rule that the source books and their authors are never named in the output, enforced in code: a violating draft is retried once with a sharpene
